yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No independent absolute date is spoken. YAML supplies May 29–June 1, 1748 as the candidate campaign span.
yamlCheck.explanation: Two overnight transitions are explicit. The slower, compressed return journey and its initial estimate do not establish an exact total. The YAML span can fit but is not independently matched; visions and the journey flashback do not add elapsed days. Heading to bed at the end does not reach another morning.
